nom: Drunk Elephant Protini Polypeptide Firming Moisturizer

segments.oily: Reviewers with oily or acne-prone skin describe it as lightweight and non-comedogenic, saying it hydrates without adding shine or triggering new breakouts, though one notes an occasional small whitehead.
segments.dry: One dry, mature-skin reviewer found it insufficiently moisturizing and even flaky after a week, while another with normal-to-dry skin found it light and irritation-free.
segments.combination: A combination oily/dry reviewer had a severe breakout after one to two uses despite no issues with other Drunk Elephant products; another combination-skin reviewer found it hydrating without heaviness.
segments.sensitive: Sensitive and rosacea-prone reviewers repeatedly call this one of the few moisturizers that doesn't cause redness, rash, or irritation, describing it as calming and non-clogging, though one reviewer with a formula-change concern and another with very sensitive skin reported redness, milia, or mild irritation.
segments.normal: Normal-skin reviewers describe it as lightweight, non-greasy, and suited to daily use under makeup.
segments.mature: Mature-skin reviewers in their 40s-60s widely credit it with smoother, firmer, less crepey skin over long-term use, though one 50-year-old menopausal reviewer found it left her skin dry and flaky.

concerns.aging: Most mature reviewers report smoother texture, less visible fine lines, and a firmer, more lifted look with regular long-term use; one reviewer explicitly found no improvement in tone, texture, or firmness despite the claims.
concerns.dehydration: Many reviewers describe it as hydrating without greasiness and note their skin feels soft and rehydrated; a few with dry or mature skin found it left their skin dry or flaky.
concerns.redness: Rosacea and sensitive reviewers consistently report reduced redness and no flare-ups; one reviewer had the opposite experience with sudden facial redness after purchasing a newly ordered jar.
concerns.barrier: Several sensitive and allergy-prone reviewers say it is one of the few products that doesn't provoke a reaction or rash, calming irritated skin; one reviewer reported a rash and irritation from a specific jar she believed had a different formula.
concerns.spots: Reviewers with acne-prone or teenage skin report clearer skin and fewer blemishes within weeks; two reviewers describe sudden, severe breakouts after starting the product.
concerns.blemishes: Several oily/acne-prone reviewers say it does not cause new breakouts and even improves smoothness and clarity; one reviewer had occasional small whiteheads and another had a severe reaction with crying-inducing breakouts.
concerns.oiliness: Oily-skin reviewers consistently describe it as non-greasy and even slightly matte, controlling shine without overdrying, though one found the matte finish too flat for her preference.

aspects.libelle: Half-full or small-feeling jar for price
Refill pump often fails to work
No fragrance or mild pleasant scent

extraits.texte: I got this moisturizer and I heard amazing reviews about it. I got it while being indesicive on its price, but still got it to treat myself on my birthday. After about 1-2 uses I broke out so bad! Weird because I never ever break out. My skin is usually amazing and fine with products. This broke me out so bad to the point I was crying so hard to even move my face! I would never even think about buying again and would NOT recommend getting it. And my skin is a mixture of oily and dry. Although, I have tried other products from Drunk Elephant and they have been fine, so I guess this moisturizer just doesn't work for me. 🤷‍♀️

I did a lot of research to find a really strong cream-based moisturizer for my aging skin. I'm 50 going through menopause so my skin is changing dramatically. I bought this after hearing, reading and seeing positive results. Well, it didn't work at all for me. My skin was dry and even flaky after using it for a week. I wish that I wouldn't have bought sick a big size.

This is one of the very few moisturizers that doesn't cause my very sensitive rosacia skin to react. There is no noticeable scent or highly active ingredients. For me, Protini is a gentle and neutral moisturizer with a medium to light creamy texture that provides a medium level of moisture. I've used this for years and it's my go-to moisturizer. In the warm months I used it exclusively, but in the winter when it is icy cold out, I may also add the Lala Retro Whipped moisturizer to the cheek area at night.

extraits.titre: This is a critical element of my skin care
extraits.texte: I have been using Protini since it came out. It is perfect for my maturing skin. I have compared the Protini ingredients to medical grade brands and Protini beats them all for my skin. It has just the right amount of daily hydration - absorbs quickly - isn't sticky or greasy - it feels wonderful on the skin and doesn't make makeup pill. The value size is a bonus. The container is perfect - it dispenses a single shot and prevents contamination found in other products that are in a jar. It a perfect product and I love it.

I have very oily acne probe skin. I dont use any moisturizers on my face cuz i usually break out. Im 38 about to be 39. I saw the reviews and decided to buy it. It is expensive but i truly have to say its worth the price. I been using it for about 3/4 months now. I was using it consistantly the first month at night but i noticed maybe 1 day out of the week I was waking up with a tiny white head. I use it a few times a week now. I actually like using it in the morning before i put my makeup on. My daughter whos 13 I caught using it and I laughed but she actually loves it haha .. i did notice the pump after a while wouldn't pump the cream out so i had to keep pumping and it started working fine adtwr that. A little goes a long way. My skin does feel a lil irritated if i clunk it on but if i put just the right anount its fine. Like i said, my skin is very sensitive. Its smooth, smells pleasant , lightweight and very moisturizing. I personally will continue to buy it. The peice is outrageous but you pay for what u get.

extraits.titre: Great for older skin and rosacea
extraits.texte: Drunk Elephant Portini Polypeptide Cream has become my Holy Grail of moisturizer. I am over 40, so I've tried many moisturizers to address the needs of aging skin. This moisturizer gave me exactly what I need. Also, I have rosacea, so it's important that I use a moisturizer that doesn't irritate or flare my skin. I've noticed improvement in the redness since using Protini.

USE WITH CAUTION! I recently ordered a new one late October. For reference my last Protini was purchased July 2025. I have no idea what happened but within hours of application my face became red, I woke up the next day and had small milia/whiteheads, all over my face and neck along with a lovely rash. Stopped using it immediately, reached out to the company to confirm any formula changes, to which they said there was none. Returned the product but am still wondering what happened as I have been using this particular cream for years and never had an issue. If you plan to start using this cream or even get a new one, start using it when you have no important events coming up, just in case you have a reaction.
